```yaml
name: Test Cookiecutter Template

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run pytest
        run: uv run pytest tests/

  test-generated-project:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        orm: ["tortoise", "beanie"]
        docker: ["y", "n"]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock"

      - name: Install cookiecutter
        run: uv tool install cookiecutter

      - name: Generate project
        run: |
          cookiecutter . \
            --no-input \
            --overwrite-if-exists \
            project_name="Test Project" \
            project_slug="test_project" \
            author_name="Test Author" \
            email="test@example.com" \
            description="A test project" \
            open_source_license="MIT" \
            use_docker="${{ matrix.docker }}" \
            use_heroku="n" \
            use_docker_compose="n" \
            use_ruff="y" \
            use_mypy="y" \
            use_pytest="y" \
            use_django="n" \
            use_fastapi="y" \
            use_sqlalchemy="n" \
            use_alembic="n" \
            use_celery="n" \
            use_gunicorn="n" \
            use_uvicorn="y" \
            use_daphne="n"

      - name: Validate generated project structure
        working-directory: ./test_project
        run: |
          # Check for essential files
          test -f pyproject.toml || (echo "Missing pyproject.toml" && exit 1)
          test -f README.md || (echo "Missing README.md" && exit 1)
          test -d app || (echo "Missing app directory" && exit 1)

      - name: Validate Python syntax
        working-directory: ./test_project
        run: find . -name '*.py' -exec python -m py_compile {} +

      - name: Check for unreplaced template variables
        working-directory: ./test_project
        run: |
          if grep -r "{{cookiecutter\." . --include="*.py" --include="*.toml" --include="*.md" --include="*.yaml" --include="*.yml" --include="*.env" --include="*.txt" --include="*.cfg" --include="*.ini" --include="*.json" --include="*.html" --include="*.css" --include="*.js" --include="*.sh" --include="*.dockerfile" --include="Dockerfile" --include="docker-compose.yml" --include="docker-compose.yaml"; then
            echo "Found unreplaced cookiecutter variables"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install dependencies with uv
        working-directory: ./test_project
        run: uv sync || true

      - name: Test basic imports
        working-directory: ./test_project
        run: |
          uv run python -c "import app" || true
          uv run python -c "from app.main import app" || true
```
